en: A black and white image of a quiet street in a European town, lined with early 20th-century buildings. On the right, a large building with the sign 'Krankenhaus' (hospital in German) and ornate architectural details is visible. A child is pushing a pram down the street, and a few adults are visible in the distance. The street is largely empty, and the atmosphere is peaceful and historical.
